notes: Chain-link fabric: galvanised wire woven into diamonds, alpha-cut so the lot behind it shows. Pixelcoat 0.56.0, for Zoo's `chain_link_fence` (the walker, 2026-10-04: a fenced vacant lot across the through road, 'empty lot is a good start'). A 1 m tile with 16 diamonds across it, 62.5 mm on a side -- the common 2 to 2.5 inch mesh. `wire` 0.14 of the diamond period keeps about a quarter of the tile, the wire and its knuckles; real fabric reads between 15 and 25 per cent covered. One theme-neutral profile mapped by every level theme: chain link is a commodity, galvanised the same in Delco as anywhere, and the wear is rust at the knuckles. THE WEAVE (from the walker's references, 2026-10-04): chain link is zig-zag strands hooked over and under each other, not straight wires crossing, so the albedo's meso band is the same mesh in `weave` mode -- a round highlight on each wire, darkened where it passes under its neighbour -- at the cutout's own count, so the shading lands on the wires the cutout keeps. Real wire geometry, which the references build, is out on cost: a 180 m street of it is hundreds of thousands of triangles.
